topic: Tool events of unpinned sessions are not logged
detail: SP-014 stores only events orchd can attribute to a pinned session or a running task; events from a harness with no pin (started before the hooks were installed, or whose PinSession failed), from the operator, or from a task orchd cannot find are counted by caller kind and dropped. Decide whether SP-017's 'unpinned' sessions should get a chain keyed by their harness process.
note: Settled by the user on 2026-11-10: unpinned processes get a chain of their own; see D-36 and SP-073.
